messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wipe‑down, remove dust from the fretboard, and tune it to standard pitch. | A clean, well‑tuned instrument looks cared for and gives buyers confidence. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | • Use natural light.
• Capture front, back, side, headstock, soundhole, and any flaws.
• Include a reference object (e.g., a coin or ruler). | Clear images reduce questions and show the guitar’s true condition. | | **3. Write an Honest Description** | • Brand, model, year, wood type, finish, and serial number.
• Note any scratches, dents, or repairs.
• Mention accessories (case, strap, picks). | Transparency builds trust and reduces post‑sale disputes. | | **4. Research Comparable Prices** | Search listings on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music forums. | Helps set a realistic asking price and shows you’re informed. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces:** Reverb (music‑specific), eBay, Etsy (handmade/collectibles), Facebook Marketplace.
• **Local Options:** Craigslist, Nextdoor, local classifieds, music‑store bulletin boards.
• **Consignment Shops:** Local instrument stores often take guitars on consignment. | Multiple venues increase exposure; choose what fits your comfort level. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. | Buyers expect some haggling; a higher starting point keeps you from underselling. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. In‑Person Sale** | • **Shipping:** Use a sturdy hard case or custom foam box, add packing peanuts, and insure the package.
• **In‑Person:** Meet in a public place (coffee shop, police station parking lot) or at a local music store. | Shipping expands your market but adds cost; in‑person saves money but requires safety precautions. | | **8. Secure Payment** | • For online sales: PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo (if you trust the buyer), or a bank transfer with tracking.
• For local sales: Cash or a verified mobile payment app. | Protects against fraud and ensures you receive funds before handing over the guitar. | | **9. Prepare Shipping Materials (if applicable)** | • Hard case or custom foam box.
• Packing peanuts or bubble wrap.
• Heavy‑duty tape and a “Fragile” label.
• Insurance (recommended for valuable instruments). | Proper packaging prevents damage during transit and protects you legally. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | • Confirm the buyer’s details (address, contact info).
• Send a signed receipt or transaction confirmation.
• If shipping, provide tracking information immediately. | Documentation protects both parties and provides proof of sale. | ### Quick Tips * **Safety First:** If meeting locally, bring a friend or meet in a well‑lit, busy area. Never let strangers into your home just to inspect the guitar. * **Return Policy:** Offer a short return window (e.g., 48 hrs) only if you’re comfortable inspecting the instrument again. This can boost buyer confidence. * **Negotiation Strategy:** Be prepared to lower the price by 10–15 % if the buyer wants a quick deal. Keep your bottom line in mind. * **Keep Records:** Save screenshots of your listing, messages, and receipts. This helps resolve disputes later. --- #### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2010 Martin D-28 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition – Includes Case Description: - Brand: Martin - Model: D-28 - Year: 2010 - Wood: Spruce top, Mahogany back & sides - Finish: Natural - Serial #: 12345678 - Accessories: Original case, strap, picks - Condition: Minor scratch on the back near the bridge, otherwise pristine. Tuned to standard EADGBE. - Notes: Recently had a new nut installed and was professionally cleaned. Price: $1,200 (Open to reasonable offers) Photos: [Attach 8 high‑resolution images] Contact: Please send a private message with your offer or ask any questions. Thank you! ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your own guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
